sources.title: Updates to RBC Cash Back Credit Cards
sources.notes: States the October 1, 2026 effective date, the new earn rates, the Preferred fee increase to $120, purchase APR 21.99%, removal of annual caps, Costco/Walmart warehouse treatment, and the VIP Banking rebate of up to $120.

sources.title: RBC cash back credit cards comparison
sources.notes: New-applicant comparison: no-fee and Preferred fees, APRs, income test, and welcome headlines. Apply-by date February 2, 2027.

sources.title: RBC Cash Back Mastercard
sources.notes: Live product page: $0 fee, 21.99% purchase APR, unlimited 2% groceries, 1% gas/EV/transit/rideshare, 0.5% other, and 5% extra on the first $2,000 within 6 months.

sources.title: RBC Cash Back Preferred World Elite Mastercard
sources.notes: Live product page confirms $120, 21.99%, income test, and unlimited 3%/1% category rates. A benefits PDF and some search snippets still describe the pre-October $99 and 1.5% schedule. Those older documents are not used for the October 1, 2026 term.

sources.title: RBC ION Visa
sources.notes: No annual fee, 20.99% purchase APR, 1.5 points on groceries, gas, EV, transit, rideshare, streaming, and digital gaming, 1 point otherwise. Gift-card example: 1,400 points = $10. Welcome apply-by November 4, 2026. The page does not state a rule start date.

sources.title: RBC ION+ Visa
sources.notes: $48 annual fee. 3 points named for groceries, gas, dining, food delivery, rideshare, and streaming. EV charging, transit, and digital gaming are included at 3 points because the page says “and more” and the ION Visa page defines that everyday group. That mapping is disclosed on the card.

sources.title: RBC rewards credit cards comparison
sources.notes: Comparison table for ION, ION+, More Rewards, and moi, including welcome headlines and 20.99% purchase APRs. Moi: 500 points = $4.

sources.title: RBC Avion Visa Infinite
sources.notes: $120 fee, 20.99% purchase APR, income test, 1.25 points on travel and 1 point otherwise, Elite membership. Published travel conversion on the page: 100 points = $1. Fixed flight chart is not a flat rate. Welcome components: 35,000 on approval, 20,000 after $5,000 in six months, 15,000 anniversary.

sources.title: RBC travel credit cards comparison
sources.notes: Comparison table for Avion Infinite, Avion Platinum, Avion Infinite Privilege, both WestJet cards, and British Airways Visa Infinite. Fees, income tests, purchase APRs, and headline earn rates. Avion Platinum and Infinite Privilege welcome splits were not verified beyond the headline.

sources.title: RBC no annual fee credit cards comparison
sources.notes: Used for More Rewards Visa Infinite earn rates and income test. The same page’s cash-back column still used pre-October wording in search snippets, so this card is marked partial.

sources.title: RBC Visa Classic Low Rate Option
sources.notes: Published comparison figures: $20 annual fee and 12.99% purchase and cash-advance APR. A first-year fee waiver and 0.99% balance-transfer rate were advertised with apply-by dates of June 15, 2026 and September 30, 2026. Both are before the comparison date, so the waiver is not applied. No rewards earn rate was published.

sources.title: RBC prime rate on the mortgage rates page
sources.notes: Royal Bank prime 4.450% on the mortgage rates page retrieved October 1, 2026. The last posted change on the online-banking rates page was 2025-10-30. Not used in a ranked product because RateAdvantage’s applicant spread is disclosed only at application.

sources.title: Avion Rewards redemption overview
sources.notes: Describes gift cards, merchandise, and travel. It does not publish a single cents-per-point rate. Numeric Avion rates come from the card pages instead.
